name: docket-plugin-open-in-code
description: docket 플러그인 예제 — 바뀐 파일을 VS Code 로 연다 (TS → wasm)

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/index.js && extism-js dist/index.js -i src/index.d.ts -o plugin.wasm
scripts.pack: npm run build && tar -a -cf open-in-code.zip plugin.json plugin.wasm
